events.verdict: Westbrook (DEN) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) legally contests Gordon's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Westbrook (DEN) and Alexander-Walker (MIN) come together at the same spot, and the contact as they pursue the rebound is marginal.

Alexander-Walker's (MIN) forearm makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Westbrook (DEN).  Any ensuing contact with Westbrook's hand/arm after the ball is dislodged is considered incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Westbrook (DEN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Timberwolves.
Porter Jr. (DEN) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Nuggets.
Randle (MIN) cleanly deflects the ball away from Jokic (DEN) as they pursue the rebound.
Gordon (DEN) cleanly deflects the ball away from Gobert (MIN) as they pursue the rebound.
Edwards (MIN) is moving to Braun's (DEN) side and grazes his left elbow as Braun cuts back towards the basket, and the contact is marginal.
Randle (MIN) absorbs the body to body contact from Braun (DEN) and he avoids making contact with Braun's right arm as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) and Jokic (DEN) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Gobert (MIN) jumps in a vertical position and absorbs the body to body contact from Braun (DEN) during the driving shot attempt.
Braun (DEN) commits a take foul on Gobert (MIN).  Coach Finch's (MIN) attempt to request a timeout is not recognized as the foul occurs prior to the timeout attempt.
Jokic (DEN) is bracing for the contact from Gobert (MIN), and the contact as he releases away to the perimeter is marginal.
Gobert (MIN) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
